title: Carpentry & Woodworking
shortDescription: Build confidence with measuring, hand tools, timber and simple joints.
description: Start with accurate measuring and workshop safety, then explore timber, hand tools and the principles behind simple joints. The course introduces practical habits that help new carpenters prepare for supervised work.
objectives: Recognize common timber types and defects
Explain how simple woodworking joints fit together

modules.title: Workshop safety and measuring
modules.summary: Prepare a safe workspace and make clear, accurate marks.

lessons.title: A safe and organized workshop
lessons.description: Set up a clean workspace, store tools safely and understand the importance of eye and hearing protection.

lessons.title: Measure, mark and check
lessons.description: Practice reading a tape measure, using a try square and marking a cut line clearly.

modules.title: Timber and hand tools
modules.summary: Understand wood grain, common defects and essential hand tools.

lessons.title: Choosing and checking timber
lessons.description: Compare common timber, follow the grain and look for warping, splits and other visible defects.

lessons.title: Saws, chisels and planes
lessons.description: Explore the basic jobs of common hand tools and safe ways to carry and store them.

modules.title: Cuts and simple joints
modules.summary: Learn the principles behind clean cuts and beginner joinery.

lessons.title: Planning a clean cut
lessons.description: Follow a marked line, support the workpiece and check the cut before assembly.

lessons.title: How basic joints fit together
lessons.description: Understand butt, lap and simple corner joints and why accurate marking matters.
